req.title: Reject non-positive redirect count
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the redirect count is zero or negative.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/{n} must return HTTP 400 when n <= 0. The violation was test[4] (test_redirect_large_negative_returns_400) having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. A negative test exercising a representative member of the invalid partition should use heuristic=NEG, not EP. EP is reserved for positive equivalence partitioning. Fix: change heuristic on test[4] from EP to NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_returns_400
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /redirect/0 via Flask test client with follow_redirects=False
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: n=0 is the exact boundary value; assert n > 0 fails at n=0
BVA: tests the exact threshold value (0) that separates valid from invalid
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_zero_returns_400():
    r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 400, f'Expected 400 for n=0, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code != 500

test_redirect_zero_returns_400()

tests.name: test_redirect_zero_vs_one_boundary_contrast
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Compare status codes to confirm exact boundary behaviour
expected: The two status codes are different
trace: R-HTTPBIN-023: contrasts n=0 (rejected) with n=1 (accepted) in one test
BVA: catches off-by-one mutations on the > vs >= operator in assert n > 0
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_zero_vs_one_boundary_contrast():
    r0 = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r0.status_code == 400, f'Expected 400 for n=0, got {r0.status_code}'
    assert r1.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302 for n=1, got {r1.status_code}'
    assert r0.status_code != r1.status_code

test_redirect_zero_vs_one_boundary_contrast()
